roadmap.standing_rules: Example-based tests; proptest where a stub names one. Un-pend only in the owning step; never re-author scenarios. Change a remapped stub's id before un-ignoring. Runtime sqlx::query only. Mutation >= 80% on modified Rust. One local commit per step.
roadmap.lane_preamble: export FOUNDRY_XTASK_INCLUDE_DOCKER=1 RUST_TEST_THREADS=1; source lane_env. Before every lane run eip_pre (foreign-listener and other-session check); run every lane under timeout. Before eip-restart, eip-metrics and the bench, warm the release foundry binary (eip_warm, CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_BUILD_OVERRIDE_STRIP=false). Each step runs its stubs' crate tests and eip_lane for each tag in its lanes; then git add -N and eip_mut on its mutation_targets, gate >= 80% kill rate. lane_common at each phase end. Until 01-01 creates scripts/eip-lanes.sh, 01-01 uses the inline equivalents.
